notes_for_editor: Only one page describes this tower: the Forest Lookouts c.1938 entry. Nothing read gives a builder, staffing, fate or site description. The brief's height (12.2 m) matches the 40 ft in that entry. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Illinois list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/il/) has five Pope County entries (Deputy, Massac, McCormick, Raum, Williams Hill), all marked Gone, and no Benham Hill. The historical marker is forest context only and does not name this site. A Forest Service page says Trigg Tower began as a 60 ft wood structure, while the marker says 40 ft; this is not used here. Two WebSearch queries found no other Benham Hill tower source; search-result summaries (including a mapping-site elevation) were not used. The story is about 130 words, the most this evidence supports without padding. The record's kind 'tower' and agency are consistent with the source.
